The company has market cap of $920.90 billion. The firm also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. It has a 19.32 P/E ratio. It offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers.
